clues.text: God told Joshua that after a long ram's horn blast and a mighty shout, this city's wall would collapse.
Joshua secretly sent two spies to inspect this city, and they stayed in the house of Rahab.
As Jesus passed through this city, a short, wealthy tax collector climbed a sycamore tree to see Him.
In Jesus' parable, a man going down the road to this city was stripped and beaten by robbers.
Blind Bartimaeus sat begging beside the road as Jesus and His disciples were leaving this city.
When its men told Elisha their water was bad, he threw salt from a new bowl into their spring.
In Ahab's days, Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt this city at the cost of his firstborn and youngest sons.
